Monsoon season brings advice on home care, health, and travel

Multiple Indian media outlets are providing advice and information related to the monsoon season. Centrist outlets like Jansatta are offering tips on managing household pests like centipedes in bathrooms, preparing monsoon-friendly recipes such as ragi soup and chutneys, and general monsoon cooking advice. Right-leaning outlets, including Punjab Kesari, Zee News, News18 Hindi, and Aaj Tak, are focusing on health and safety, advising on avoiding wild animals, dealing with hair fall, preventing skin infections, protecting bedding from moisture, and proper storage of food items like semolina. Some outlets are also suggesting travel destinations for monsoon lovers.
